name: Rune Ring
description: A darker forged-metal ring with restrained amber runic engraving.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Decorative runes carry no gameplay meaning. The wind and lubber silhouettes intentionally match Classic Wood for cross-skin readability.

orientationConventions.ring: North is at 12 o'clock in the source texture. Apply heading only to the rose transform.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The spear tip points to 12 o'clock at world bearing 0. The circular boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); mount it on the rose and apply pure world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Static screen-space layer. The downward point is baked at 12 o'clock and marks the player's facing.
